chunks: And in a report of Ibn Muskann, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:
The boundary of what the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) sanctified from Al-Medina is from Dhubab to Waqim, and Al-Ureyz and An-Naqb from the front of Makkah.

key_terms.حَرَّمَ: Sanctified / Made sacred (referring to the Haram area)

ai.seo_question: What are the specific geographical boundaries of the sanctified area of Medina according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi delineates the precise geographical limits of Medina's Haram, establishing a legal precedent for the sanctity of the city's boundaries as defined by the Prophet. By citing specific landmarks like Dhubab and Waqim, it provides the Shi'a juristic basis for determining the extent of the sacred zone where hunting and cutting vegetation are prohibited, mirroring the status of Makkah.
